tagline: Relive the old seasons — on your own private server
authSub: Sign in to jump into the Fortnite saga
passwordHint: 8+ characters — PBKDF2-hashed, never stored in plain text
vEnterUser: Enter your username or email first
errTaken: That username or email is already taken
gameVersionsSub: CloudDir manifests verified from the Epic CDN — delta-chain discovery
partyhubSub: The Kairos companion app — now served straight from the Owen backend
redirecterSub: libowen.so — curl hook + ART hooks + auto manifest
aboutBody: The full Owen Launcher ported to safe Rust — no Kotlin, no C. The built-in Owen Server covers it all: real accounts and a locally hosted PartyHub.
offlineSub: Cannot reach the Owen backend — retrying automatically
chooseLanguageSub: The same languages Fortnite ships with
setupSub: Owen needs two permissions and your player name. They are checked on every launch until granted.
installPermDesc: Owen needs permission to install the patched game APK.
batteryDesc: Exempt Owen from battery optimization so the local backend keeps running.
setupNote: After granting, come back to this screen — it refreshes automatically.
playerNameNote: The name is sent to the game on launch, like the Owen web login.
seasonsTagline: Relive the old days — every season, every build
uninstallBody: This will remove the patched game from your device. Owen marks will be cleared too.
cleanReinstallDesc: The installed copy was signed by another source, so it must be removed once. Owen will then install the already-patched build from the cache — no re-download, no re-patch.
waitingRemoval: Waiting for the old copy to be removed...
installingCache: Installing the Owen build from the cache...
oldStillInstalled: The old copy is still installed. Confirm the uninstall in the system dialog, then try again.
notInCache: The patched build is not in the cache yet — press Launch once to patch and install it.
sigConflict: Signature conflict — the installed game uses a different signature.
backendNotRunning: The Owen Server is not running.
backendHint: Check the backend status in the seasons screen settings.
hostingSub: Run the Owen Server from inside the app whenever you need it — stop it with a tap.
autoDesc: Redirect every build automatically to the closest matching release.
fixedDesc: Redirect every build to one version you pick.
offDesc: No redirecting — exact manifest matching only.
previewNote: Preview mode: download & install run on an Android device or desktop.
